OHRC.name: Orbital High Resolution Camera
OHRC.description: High resolution optical imaging (0.25m/pixel) from 100km lunar polar orbit.

TMC-2.name: Terrain Mapping Camera-2
TMC-2.description: Stereo triplets for high-resolution 3D digital elevation models and lunar orthomosaics.

IIRS.name: Imaging Infrared Spectrometer
IIRS.description: Hyperspectral imaging for mineralogical mapping and OH/H2O absorption features.

LROC.name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (NAC/WAC)
LROC.type: Optical Narrow Angle Camera / Wide Angle Camera
LROC.description: High resolution lunar reference products (LROC NAC CDR/EDR, Ortho, and DTMs).
